sdr.title: Autonomous AI SDR
sdr.subtitle: B2B outreach: Apollo → Smartlead/Instantly → autonomous replies with GDPR. Never sends via own SMTP.
sdr.campaignRenamed: Name updated in CRM and Smartlead
sdr.deleteCampaignConfirm:
Delete campaign “{{name}}”?

Its leads and conversations in Astoha will be removed. The Smartlead campaign is NOT deleted automatically.
sdr.needCampaign: Create or select a campaign first
sdr.needProvisionOrId: Create the Smartlead campaign (button) or paste a Campaign ID
sdr.needMailbox: Select the Smartlead mailbox for this campaign
sdr.mailboxHint: Pick this brand's mailbox. On create/recreate we automatically remove other Smartlead workspace inboxes.
sdr.mailboxOtherBrandWarn: This mailbox is outside the configured brand domains. Check BRAND_MAIL_DOMAINS in AiSdrPanel.
sdr.outreachIdAutoHint: Filled automatically when you click “Create in Smartlead”. You can still paste an ID manually.
sdr.provisionReused: Smartlead reused · same campaign_id {{id}} (no new campaign)
sdr.reprovisionConfirm:
Create a NEW Smartlead campaign?

OK = new (ID will change).
Cancel = reuse the linked campaign (recommended).
sdr.repairDone: Sequence + schedule applied in Smartlead. Click “Start Smartlead” if it is still Draft/Paused.
sdr.repairError: Could not repair the Smartlead sequence
sdr.startError: Could not move the campaign out of Draft/Paused
sdr.actionsLegendCreate: • Create / Reuse Smartlead: attaches mailbox + sequence + schedule. By default it does NOT create another campaign if an ID exists; only creates new if you confirm.
sdr.actionsLegendRepair: • Repair: rewrites sequence and schedule on the linked Smartlead campaign (briefly pauses it).
sdr.actionsLegendStart: • Start: resume only (Paused/Draft → ACTIVE), without rewriting the sequence. If Smartlead asks to confirm Resume, accept (the bounce note is a generic warning).
sdr.actionsLegendLaunch: • Launch: generates emails with AI (or with the handwritten template, if that mode is on), uploads leads to the existing campaign, and starts it. It does not rewrite copy already saved.
sdr.actionsLegendRegenerate: • Rewrite copy: replaces the prompt with the recommended one and rewrites emails 1–3 for leads who have not replied. In “Write by hand” it leaves the prompt alone and fills the written emails for each lead. Mail already sent stays sent; Smartlead uses the new text on steps that have not gone out.
sdr.generateManualConfirm:
Emails 1, 2 and 3 are filled from the text you wrote, for every lead who has not replied yet.

Replies, unsubscribes and bounces are left as they are. An email already sent cannot be recalled.

Continue?
sdr.copyModeManualHint: Write the subject and body once. The buttons insert each person's data at the cursor. Generate emails fills them in for everyone who has not replied yet.
sdr.manualMissingStep: Write the subject and body of email {{step}} before generating.
sdr.regenerateConfirm:
This replaces the prompt with the recommended one and rewrites emails 1–3 for leads who have not replied, in short batches.

Keep this tab open: it can take several minutes, and it no longer stops at the 2 minute limit.

Replies, unsubscribes and bounces are left as they are. An email already sent cannot be recalled.

Continue?
sdr.regeneratePartial: {{count}} rewritten before the error. Click again to continue. {{error}}
sdr.actionsLegendPaused: • Paused ≠ outside hours. Paused = deliberately paused (e.g. after Repair). Outside hours usually looks ACTIVE with no sends. If Paused, click Start.
sdr.promptResetHint: Prompt updated in the editor — click Save settings
sdr.cadenceHint: Current cadence: day 0 → follow-up day {{followup}} → reminder day {{reminder}}. No reply → lost after {{lost}} days.
sdr.settingsDesc: Per-campaign settings. Saved / repaired / launched values are applied to Smartlead.
sdr.lostAfterDaysHint: From first contact, with no reply
sdr.maxLeadsPerDayHint: First campaign: 20. Raise it only after the first sends stay under a 2% bounce rate.
sdr.metricsFromSmartlead: Leads, sent, opens, clicks, replies and bounces come from Smartlead. Demos come from the CRM.
sdr.enrichDesc: First campaign: Spain only, R&D or funding titles, companies of 11–500 people. CIDETEC, Ideko and Talgo are excluded.
sdr.companySizesHint: Each range keeps its internal comma (51,200). Separate multiple ranges with semicolons (;), not commas.
sdr.excludeDomainsHint: Customers are always excluded. A lost company stays out only while its last contact is newer than those days; after that Apollo can search it again. The rest of the CRM, even if never contacted, is not excluded.
sdr.enrichDone: Apollo: {{found}} found · {{inserted}} new · {{updated}} updated · {{noEmail}} without email
sdr.enrichNoEmails: Apollo found {{found}} profiles, but {{noEmail}} had no unlocked email. Nothing was saved. Redeploy sdr-enrich-leads (bulk_match) or check Apollo reveal credits.
sdr.campaignConfigDesc: Prompt, Calendly demo, ESP. Email language is per lead (country), not one language for the whole campaign.
sdr.fallbackLanguageHint: Only used when a lead has no language/country. Each email is written in the lead's language (from country), not the campaign's. You can override it in the Leads table.
sdr.calendlyOwnerPlaceholder: Pick a teammate with a saved link
sdr.calendlyOwnerHint: Pick who will run the demo. Their link is saved under Employees, in that person's commercial identity.
sdr.promptCadenceHint: Email 1 asks one pain question about that company, with paragraphs and a sign-off. Email 2 picks up that pain, sends the video and explains the product. Email 3 thanks them. No grant-history lookup.
sdr.gdprNote: Every email includes a GDPR opt-out footer. Smartlead cadence 0/3/7; no reply after the sequence → lost. Unsubscribes update consent_status and the ESP.
sdr.leadsDesc: Add a CRM lead by hand or pull profiles from Apollo. Search, filter, delete, or launch a selection.
sdr.leadsEmpty: No leads yet. Add one from the CRM or run Apollo.
sdr.addFromCrm: Add a lead from the CRM
sdr.addFromCrmHint: Search by name, company or email. It is copied into this campaign as discovered and is not sent until you launch it.
sdr.leadsFilterEmpty: No leads match this search or filter.
sdr.inboxEmpty: No contacted or replied leads yet.
sdr.selectLead: Select a lead to view the thread.

agente.title: AI Sales Agent
agente.subtitle: Prospecting and drafts stay in a human validation queue. Nothing is sent without approval.

agente.dedupHint: No email is generated if that address was already contacted for this startup, if the company was contacted within 30 days, or if it is on the suppression list.
agente.namedPriorityHint: Order: named contacts first; generic inboxes (info@, marketing@…) last. The daily cron uses the same rule when picking from CRM.
agente.leadEditDesc: Change name, email or company. Save to update the prospecting base.

agente.unsubscribeNote: Every send includes an unsubscribe footer. A click adds the address to the suppression list.

agente.inboundDesc: Replies to {{startup}} outreach. The suggested answer waits for your approval.
